values.title: Build a Small Desk Shelf
values.text: A project sheet for planning, measuring, and learning through a first build.

values.alt: A conceptual shelf and material diagram
values.caption: Illustrative plan only; adapt dimensions and methods to your materials.

values.text:
## Materials to plan

- Shelf board
- Two supports
- Suitable fixings
- A finish appropriate to the material

Check dimensions, stability, and tool instructions before building.

## Build sequence

1. Sketch the intended size and purpose.
2. Check the space where it will sit.
3. Mark dimensions before cutting.
4. Test the fit before final assembly.
5. Inspect the finished piece before use.

values.title: Before the first cut
values.items:
Check material dimensions
Read tool instructions
Prepare a clear work area
Mark the cut lines
